message: `ddt` of a value that already depends on a time derivative is a second time derivative
description: A contribution or variable takes `ddt` of something that itself contains `ddt`, directly or through a variable. This simulator carries one charge channel per contribution, which expresses a first time derivative only; a second derivative has no place in it, and dropping either `ddt` would change what the model says.
actions: Introduce an internal node for the first derivative and take `ddt` of its potential, for example `V(d) <+ ddt(x); I(p, n) <+ ddt(V(d));`.
